scope.mode: regression review only (all fixes deterministic, verified by rerun; no items scored per README)
scope.method: Pixel diff (threshold 8/255) of all 30 baseline/current pairs; visual inspection of 1280 default pair; diff.json introduced/persisting instance review. No probes run; motion changes (transition: all removed, chip transition shortened) are not visible in static captures and were verified by rerun per README.

_evidence.validity: All 30 pairs share route/state/viewport/theme; identical image dimensions per pair (same page heights, so no layout shift); captures non-blank with fonts rendered.
_evidence.pixel_diff: Every light pair changes ~2,900-2,960 px, bbox confined to the .updated timestamp (1128,22) and the five .metric__label rows (y 151-169) at desktop, and the stacked label rows (x 19-190, y 91-704) at 320/375. That matches the cleared A11Y-01/A11Y-11 locations exactly. Forced-colors pairs: 0 px changed.
_evidence.diff: diff.json: cleared 5, introduced 0; no persisting finding gained run instances (base_instances == run_instances for all 13).

_notes: Not listed as a regression: in persisting COL-01 (token conformance), the cleared literal 'color: #9aa0a6' was replaced by another raw literal 'color: #4d5a52' (1 cleared, 1 introduced, net unchanged). Nothing got worse, but the contrast fix hard-codes a hex value instead of a muted-ink token. Worth tokenising when COL-01 is addressed.
No tell swap: the label colour change only darkens existing muted grey text; the palette and type stayed the same.
13 persisting design findings (nested cards, radius monotony, ghost-card shadows, spacing scale, overshoot easing, etc.) are outside this fix batch and were not judged.
No project source, fixer notes or other evaluators' outputs were read.
